title: SGM: Safety Glasses for Multimodal Large Language Models via Neuron-Level Detoxification

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the Harmful Rate (HaR) of model responses to adversarial multimodal prompts using the MM-SafetyBench and BeaverTails-V datasets, and quantifying continuous toxicity severity scores using the Perspective API.
Measuring the percentage of harmful responses specifically on the '02-Hate Speech' scenario subset of the MM-SafetyBench dataset, utilizing GPT-4-assisted evaluation followed by manual inspection.
